scope: Retrospective controlled intervention on unchanged old synthetic cohort, old LTE and LTE-derived SC checkpoint. Distinguish fixed-reference-decoder adverse feature step from direction change associated with nonlinear ReLU gate changes. No feature-space standalone correctness or unique physical cause claim. No training or new predictor.
capture: Unmodified original query_rgb, imnet forward hook captures four 4096x256 inputs for zero/native cell. Reconstruct original local-ensemble weights, area swaps, bilinear skip; endpoint parity checked every input.

intervention.path: z(s)=z0+s*(zn-z0), a feature-space chord, not intermediate cell path
intervention.sensitivity: d_mid and d_native use J at chord midpoint and native endpoint. Reference is primary, all three sign agreements disclosed; no result-driven anchor selection.
intervention.baseline: point64=sum weight*D64(z0)/2+same skip/2+.5. Same truth/reference used for every slope and full.
intervention.nonlinearity: Only original float32 captured features converted to double and copied MLP weights evaluated in double; encoder unchanged. Fixed gate excludes gate state changes but does not remove decoder weights. Zero ReLU derivative convention inactive.

evaluation.bands: RGB plus Chebyshev nonDC [0,.125),[.125,.25),[.25,.5001); exact prior definitions
evaluation.primary: Among full-direction-negative rows stable to float32-vs64 comparison, count ref positive/negative/boundary and three-anchor concordance; all full/ref direction and gain transitions retained. Numerical-sensitive rows separate, not silently classified as mechanism changes.
evaluation.eta: All 240cases scored; old center middle-band positive-to-negative a flips 14/32 LTE and16/32SC should reproduce within declared numerical sensitivity. Record reference/mid/native/full eta0->1 and residual alignment changes.
evaluation.uncertainty: Fixed dependent finite cohort descriptive counts, no independent n or population CI; 240conditions not240unique inputs; monochrome target replicatedRGB.
evaluation.transition_tables: Unqualified matrices include all rows and are explicitly labelled; stable matrices exclude numerical-sensitive rows. Eta pairs flag either endpoint sensitivity and reproduction summary gives oldfloat32 and full64 positive-to-negative counts separately, without dropping a pair.

numeric.checks: Old original point/native float32 parity per input; double decoder aggregate+skip parity; each preflight input all4branches first8queries and formal firstinput/model autograd JVP vs explicit gate derivative at all3anchors; fixed-mask full affine finite step and zero delta. Save first8 branch features/weights all inputs and double MLP weights for independent audit.
numeric.float32: Store float32 endpoint alignment/gain and compare classification with full64. Exclude sensitive direction from primary negative mechanism tally and retain complete rows.

freeze: Verify all original input/prediction/source/checkpoint hashes before inference. Hashing target bytes is allowed, but arrays not scored/read until complete new predictions/probes cohort SHA frozen. No target-driven filtering.

budget.deadline: launch start_epoch + stated seconds fixed before invoking Python; wall and script cumulative both enforced; parent timeout guard should use same bound; no resume; failure preserved and version/newroot for source changes

limitations: zero-cell contrast retained and may be OOD; no new nonzero-cell study
adverse d_ref is conditional on fixed decoder state, not feature-only error
reference/mid/native Jacobian interventions are anchor dependent; full gate counts are descriptive not proof of harm
eta jointly changes input energy/gradients and high-frequency information, not pure alias intervention
no new generalization or natural-image mechanism claim
unique sources of error cannot be identified from this intervention alone; report mixed/anchor-sensitive outcomes
